title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
abstract: arXiv:2610.32597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. translated_title: 使用模型检测器辅助大语言模型的自动化多行错误修复：以RISC-V处理器为案例研究
translated_abstract: 寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的功能验证已成为现代半导体开发中的关键瓶颈，往往消耗项目的大部分资源。调试尤其是一项非常耗时的任务，需要对仿真轨迹或反例进行仔细分析。最近的研究工作探索了将大语言模型（LLM）应用于RTL调试和修复，并展现出巨大前景。然而，现有方法通常只针对单行错误、以开环方式运行、严重依赖提示或检索、缺乏可扩展性，并且常常产生错误的修复。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的自动化RTL错误修复方法，该方法结合了大语言模型、断言和模型检测器，以提供可扩展、可信的语义基础和形式化保证。具体而言，该方法利用失败的断言来引导大语言模型为多行错误生成补丁，每个候选补丁……
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型、断言和模型检测器的自动化RTL错误修复方法，利用失败断言引导LLM生成多行错误补丁并提供形式化保证，通过RISC-V处理器的案例研究验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated RTL bug repair methodology combining LLMs, assertions, and a model checker, which leverages failing assertions to guide the LLM in generating multi-line bug patches with formal guarantees, demonstrated through a case study on RISC-V processors.
